headline: ATEEZ becomes a double million seller for the first time
sub: 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6' tops 2.05M copies in its first week
source: Source: KQ Entertainment via Yonhap News
caption:
ATEEZ just hit a milestone: their first-ever double million first-week sales! 🏴‍☠️

According to KQ Entertainment, the new mini album 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6', released Nov 13, sold more than 2.05 million copies in its first week on Hanteo Chart. It's the first time ATEEZ has crossed the 2 million mark since debut, setting a new personal best for first-week sales.

📌 Source: KQ Entertainment, via Korean media (Yonhap News)
